description: OBJECT TRACKING: say what to follow ('person', 'car, dog'); every match gets a box and label that keep their id for the whole clip, drawn over the original frames (sound kept). Up to 30 s. Nothing found is said and not charged. Paid; dryRun returns this clip's price.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

links.description: lines between the objects with their distance: sequential (in order), star (from the first), mst (shortest path), full; default 'none'

track.description: what to follow, comma separated, e.g. 'person, dog'

video.description: the video: an https / upload_file URL, a post link, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI

name: track_objects
title: Track objects in a video
